items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: I forgot who was in the quartet... And they had a gay young man called Willie Dukes sing Honeysuckle Rose

ctx.x: I forgot who was in the quartet. It was at the Three Deuces. Pearl Bailey was singing, and all she

could sing was 'St. Louis Blues.' She was getting 35 dollars a week. And they had a gay young man called Willie Dukes sing Honeysuckle Rose, honey, suck my nose, and Peewee Marquette, you know he couldn't sing.
Was that -- what year was that?
